design.purpose: A weatherproof-look open planter for herbs or flowers, with 20 cm soil depth and drainage holes in the base.

steps.c: Lay the 20 cm board flat for cutting.
Saw into front, back and two 11 cm ends.
Lay the 15 cm board flat for cutting.
Saw the 40 cm base from this board.
Drill three 10 mm drainage holes through base.
Stand the front on the base front edge.
Stand the back on the base back edge.
Fit one 11 cm end between the sides.
Fit the other end between the sides.
Sand all outside faces and top edges smooth.
Fix the front to the left end.
Fix the front to the right end.
Fix the back to the left end.
Fix the back to the right end.
Fix the base up into the front side.
Fix the base up into the back side.
Fix the base up into the left end.
Fix the base up into the right end.
